verification.method: Two independent lenses per route: capstone disassembly of the lock-equal Engine.dll and a full decode of every DAT row, by fresh-context agents that did not open the claims evidence.

ordinalNotation: Zero-based logical DAT field ordinals: a length-prefixed string is one field, a count is one field, and a counted list expands by its count. ordinalConstant is the ordinal with every count term at zero, and ordinalCountTerms is the number of counted lists the ordinal sums.
